title: A complete CNN shape and field calculation
promptMarkdown: An input has shape (batch,3,32,32). Apply an ungrouped convolution with 8 output channels, kernel 3, stride 2, padding 1, dilation 1, bias; then2×2 max pooling withstride2, no padding; then an ungrouped convolution with 16 output channels, kernel 3, stride 1, padding 0, bias. Find every output shape and learned parameter count. Calculate the receptive-field width and effective input jump after each spatial operation, and the parameter count of a final dense layer from the flattened result to5 outputs with bias.
hintLadder: Use the output formula separately at each operation.
Update receptive-field width using the previous jump.
Count one bias per output channel or dense output.
